sprint_note: Adds 'scheduled' task status with scheduled_at timestamptz column; lazy auto-promotion on active/pending page load; new Scheduled tab in UI.
summary: Lightweight single-user task management application that creates, tracks, and labels tasks with status, priority, due date, effort, and scheduled time fields, persisting tasks in Postgres and delegating label management to LabelEngine and user preferences to PreferenceStore.

classification.why_application: Owns task domain state (tasktracker.tasks table), enforces task-specific business rules (status transitions, priority validation, effort constraints, scheduled promotion logic), and wires platform services (LabelEngine, PreferenceStore) to TaskTracker-scoped behavior. Contains no reusable infrastructure.
non_goals: Background job scheduler — promotion is lazy on page load only
classification.not_platform: Task domain rules, the tasktracker.tasks schema, and the wiring of LabelEngine and PreferenceStore for this domain are TaskTracker-specific application behavior, not reusable platform infrastructure.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/tasks
exposed_surfaces.purpose: List tasks with optional status or view filter and pagination. Embeds labels per row from LabelEngine batch call. view=active and view=pending_board trigger auto-promotion before SELECT. view=scheduled returns scheduled tasks ordered by scheduled_at ASC.

params.view: one of active|pending_board|scheduled — optional; mutually exclusive with status

exposed_surfaces.name: POST /api/tasks
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Create a new task. Accepts status=scheduled with required scheduled_at. Returns created task as Dataset (single row).

exposed_surfaces.name: PATCH /api/tasks/{task_id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Partially update a task. Field omission means no change; explicit null clears nullable fields. Accepts status=scheduled and scheduled_at. Returns updated task as Dataset (single row).

exposed_surfaces.name: DELETE /api/tasks/{task_id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Delete a task. Returns empty Dataset on success.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/tasks/labels/search
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Search labels by name prefix via LabelEngine. Used for label autocomplete in the UI.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/tasks/labels/used
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return all labels attached to at least one task. Used to populate the label filter bar on mount. Gracefully degrades to empty Dataset on LabelEngine failure.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Return all labels attached to one task via LabelEngine.

exposed_surfaces.name: POST /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Attach a label by name to a task via LabelEngine.

exposed_surfaces.name: DELETE /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels/{label_id}
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Detach a label from a task via LabelEngine.

exposed_surfaces.name: PUT /api/tasks/{task_id}/labels
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Atomically replace all labels on a task. Fetches current labels, detaches each, attaches new set from body.

exposed_surfaces.name: GET /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Retrieve stored label filter selection for tasktracker.task-list from PreferenceStore. Returns Dataset (one row) or 404 ApiError if not yet saved.

exposed_surfaces.name: PUT /api/tasks/preferences/label_filter
exposed_surfaces.purpose: Persist label filter selection to PreferenceStore. Body: {label_ids: list[str]}. Returns 200 PreferenceRecord or ApiError.

internal_flow.name: startup_init
internal_flow.description: On FastAPI startup: init_pool() creates psycopg2 SimpleConnectionPool. init_schema() reads schema.sql and executes DDL idempotently. Errors are logged; application continues running.
outputs: tasktracker schema and tasks table with scheduled_at column present in Postgres

internal_flow.name: task_list
internal_flow.description: GET /tasks validates params (status or view, mutually exclusive). For view=active and view=pending_board: first executes auto-promotion UPDATE (status='scheduled' AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL AND scheduled_at::date <= CURRENT_DATE → status='in_progress', updated_at=now()), then runs the view-specific SELECT. view=active SELECT: status NOT IN ('done','pending','scheduled') UNION done tasks updated today. view=pending_board SELECT: status IN ('open','pending'). view=scheduled SELECT: status='scheduled' ORDER BY scheduled_at ASC NULLS LAST. status=<value> SELECT: status=<value>. No filter: all tasks. Embeds labels via LabelEngine batch POST. Returns Dataset.
outputs: Dataset with task rows and embedded labels

internal_flow.name: task_create
internal_flow.description: POST /tasks validates title, status (open|pending|scheduled — in_progress/done rejected), priority, effort_hours, and scheduled_at. If status=scheduled and scheduled_at is missing, returns VALIDATION_ERROR 400. Inserts row with UUID. Returns Dataset (single row).

internal_flow.name: task_update
internal_flow.description: PATCH /tasks/{task_id} validates status and priority if provided. If status=scheduled and scheduled_at not already set and not provided in body, returns VALIDATION_ERROR. Builds SET clause from only the fields present in body (using model_fields_set to support explicit null for nullable fields including scheduled_at). Executes UPDATE RETURNING *. Returns Dataset (single row) or 404 ApiError.

internal_flow.name: task_delete
internal_flow.description: DELETE /tasks/{task_id} executes DELETE RETURNING id. Returns empty Dataset or 404 ApiError if no row was deleted.

internal_flow.name: label_proxy
internal_flow.description: Label endpoints (search, used, get/attach/detach/set per task) are thin proxies to LabelEngine. TaskTracker always passes object_type=task. Results are mapped to Dataset for read endpoints. set_task_labels orchestrates fetch-detach-attach in a single LabelEngine client session.
inputs: task_id, label_name, or label_id as applicable

internal_flow.name: preference_proxy
internal_flow.description: Preference endpoints are thin proxies to PreferenceStore under scope=tasktracker.task-list. GET passes through the Dataset or 404 ApiError. PUT wraps label_ids in {value: label_ids} and forwards; passes through result.
outputs: Dataset or 404 ApiError (GET) | PreferenceRecord or ApiError (PUT)

Persists user label filter selections; TaskTracker proxies reads and writes under scope tasktracker.task-list

deferred_decisions: PATCH status=scheduled without scheduled_at in body: if the task already has a scheduled_at in the DB, this is valid; if not, it should return VALIDATION_ERROR. Implementer must fetch existing row or enforce that client always sends scheduled_at when status=scheduled. Design defers this implementation detail to the implementer; simplest approach is: if status=scheduled is in body and scheduled_at is not in model_fields_set and the existing row's scheduled_at is null, return VALIDATION_ERROR.
